activities.title: Lockhart Tea Estate, Historic Factory & Ridge Trail
activities.experience: Founded in 1879, Lockhart is one of the oldest operational orthodox tea factories in southern India. Walk through aromatic rolling machines, fermentation beds, and complete your session with artisanal cupping led by tea master Anand.
practical_logistics: Moderate 20-min estate ridge walk (comfortable sneakers recommended)
activities.field_note: "The 11 AM cupping slot is magical as morning clouds break over Lockhart Gap. Taste the imperial green and rare silver needle picking before the noon mist arrives." — Anand, Resident Tea Sommelier
activities.synergy: Pairs directly with Lockhart Gap Scenic Overlook chauffeur stop.

activities.title: Tea Museum & Lockhart Factory
activities.experience: Chronicle the pioneering transformation of the High Ranges from wilderness to lush plantations through vintage photographs, antique machinery, and tasting displays.
practical_logistics: Audio guide available in English, Hindi & Malayalam
activities.field_note: "Arrive right at opening to avoid tour coaches." — Local Field Lead

activities.title: Kolukkumalai & High Ridge Sunrise Circuit
activities.experience: Ascend to the world's highest organic tea estate at 7,900 feet in an open rugged 4x4 jeep through tea terraces into Tamil Nadu border clouds for sunrise above the clouds.
practical_logistics: Warm fleece jacket mandatory (temperatures drop to 10°C)
Bumpy off-road mountain route (not recommended for severe motion sickness)
activities.field_note: "Watch the golden sun burst across the Meesapulimala ridges while drinking hot cardamom tea at the peak." — Anand
activities.synergy: Includes mountain trail permit and jeep guide.

activities.title: Chithirapuram Valley Mountain Picnic
activities.experience: Private shaded pavilion spread with Kerala malabar parottas, slow-cooked vegetable ishtu, and fresh tropical passionfruit cordial overlooking terraced pepper vines.
practical_logistics: Vegetarian & vegan menus available upon request
Includes picnic basket and artisanal linen set
activities.field_note: "Quiet, tranquil haven midway between Lockhart and Munnar town." — Guide Note
activities.synergy: Seamless afternoon pause after Lockhart Tea Cupping.

activities.title: Chokanad Ridge Walk & Photo Point
activities.experience: Sunset mountain walk along high elevation contours with sweeping vistas of Anamudi peak and the lower valleys bathed in lilac and amber sunset mist.
practical_logistics: Gradual 180m elevation gain on cleared trails
Depart before dusk fog thickens (Ranger advisory)
activities.field_note: "The sunset colors from here are why the valley is nicknamed the Lilac Haven." — Local Ranger
activities.synergy: Day 2 golden hour grand finale before dinner transfer.
